visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man sits at a vibrant restaurant table with hotpot and beer bottles, holding a smartphone to take a photo. Neon signs with Chinese characters glow in the background. (2) He walks to a series of large, glass-door refrigerators filled with numerous yellow trays of food skewers, selecting several and stacking them on a yellow tray. (3) Returning to his table, he plunges a large handful of bamboo skewers into a steaming, bubbling divided hotpot. (4) He uses a small golden bowl to drink the hotpot soup, then removes the skewers and begins eating the meat directly from the sticks with an enthusiastic expression. (5) Close-ups show him eating specific items like ribs and chicken cartilage, followed by a thumbs-up gesture. (6) He holds his phone up to show an app interface attempting to count the skewers, then begins manually counting a large bundle of skewers at the table. (7) He approaches a white wall covered in handwritten signatures and adds his own name using a black marker.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A Chengdu-style 'Chuanchuan' hotpot restaurant with bright red and white wall panels, numerous neon signs in various colors (pink, blue, green), and industrial-style refrigerators. One wall is dedicated to customer signatures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins with an upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat. The voice is enthusiastic, describing a test for AI. (2) Sound of skewers clattering as they are picked up, followed by a 'pop' SFX. The narrator explains the 10 TWD pricing. (3) Slurping sounds are audible as the narrator drinks soup; he mentions Taiwanese soup-drinking habits. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (4) Distinct crunching sounds occur as the man bites into chicken cartilage. A 'ding' SFX emphasizes his recommendation. (5) Rhythmic counting follows: '2, 4, 6, 8...' as the skewers are counted manually against the BGM. (6) The squeaking sound of a felt-tip marker on a smooth surface is heard as the narrator signs the wall.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle and food review vlog focused on a 'Chengdu Chuanchuan' hotpot restaurant. The creator emphasizes the low cost (10 TWD per skewer) and quality of the food while introducing a comedic/tech-interest subplot where he tries to use an AI smartphone feature to count the skewers. The narrative concludes that the AI is inaccurate compared to manual counting, but the overall dining experience is highly positive.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed pricing, menu showcase, specific food recommendations, and the creator signing the restaurant's guest wall.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing styles with variety-show captions and upbeat music to maintain high viewer engagement.
